name: scholaros
tagline: A paper workbench: read, extract, cite, and ship manuscripts.
description: scholarOS turns a pile of PDFs into publishable output. Upload papers, extract text and figures, compose captions, format references in APA 7 / IEEE / Nature, check citation compliance, export to Word, and keep a literature library with a knowledge star map. Every computation runs in a local tool process; writing and rewriting use your Anna model.
